name: Chusovoy-Berezniki-Solikamsk Gas Pipeline (ChBS-1 / ChBS-2)

values.RouteNotes: No official GIS found. OSM carries partial traces (Chusovoy-Berezniki-Solikamsk 1/2, 60.8/57.2 km mapped of ~180 km each); candidate for the route-creation workflow (docs/sops/route_creation.md). Branches off the Nizhnyaya Tura-Chusovoy-Perm trunk at Chusovoy and runs north via Gubakha-Kizel-Gremyachinsk-Yayva-Aleksandrovsk area to Berezniki and Solikamsk; two parallel strings with Vilva, Usva, Kosva and Yayva river crossings.

researcher_notes: MATCH CHECK: no GEM row with Chusovoy/Berezniki/Solikamsk endpoints; Perm rows P2351/P5712/P5714/P5715/P5716 are the Nizhnyaya Tura-Perm-Gorky trunk strings (ChBS branches off that trunk at Chusovoy), so new row. CONFIRMED (2 independent: contractor Stroygazmontazh project page via Wayback, and Interfax/Kommersant reporting; Kommersant 2800669/2713838/2944561 are Interfax reprints = one wire): rebuild of two pipeline-branches Chusovoy-Berezniki-Solikamsk-1 and -2 by Gazprom transgaz Chaikovsky (Gazprom subsidiary); started summer 2012; two new 180 km strings built parallel to the 1970 (180/186 km) and 1986 (156-161 km) strings, old pipe then dismantled; ChBS-2 0-180 km fully in service mid-2015 (consumers transferred July 2015), ChBS-1 0-160 km in service and last 20 km due 1H2016 (Kommersant 22.03.2016: both work in full, all consumers connected). Contractor page: 371 km for the two strings, built 2015 (first string) and main works on second string completed 2017 (conflicts on which string/year with Kommersant; StartYear1/2 = 2015/2016 per Kommersant, flag). Serves Berezniki, Solikamsk, Gubakha, Kizel, Yayva, Aleksandrovsk. Contract value 17,538.9 mln RUB (Newsko 24.07.2012) / 17.5 bn RUB (Interfax); a cost for the whole two-string reconstruction, not per string. Length >=25 km sourced, so passes rule (d); add-threshold met (operating line GEM never captured). LENGTH: 371 km combined (contractor) vs 2x180 km (Interfax); recommend staging as TWO rows (ChBS-1 / ChBS-2) at ~180 km each (set per-string LengthKnown 180) matching GEM's per-string convention (cf. Nizhnyaya Tura-Perm I/II/III), with the 371 km as combined-check; per-string capacity, diameter and which string carries which start year not found. DIAMETER: contractor page states 500 mm and 700 mm in the spec line but 720 mm for the old strings; a web-search summary mentioned 530/720 mm but no verified page states 530, so diameter is the contractor's figure, medium confidence, unverified per string. Capacity not found. Source note: aosgm.ru domain no longer resolves; cited via Wayback capture 20210411234318. OSM seeds (60.8/57.2 km mapped) corroborate location only. Tier: high for existence/status/length/owner; medium for diameter and start years.
